file_metadata.authority: Ordo Celebrationis §57–§66; Dolnytsky Typikon Part I §1.2.1.6
file_metadata.description: Systematic ordinary of the Litiya service, outlining narthex procession, censing, petitions, return to tetrapod, and blessing of bread, wheat, wine, and oil.

roles.priest: Vest in epitrachelion and phelonion, carry hand cross, exit sanctuary through northern door, process to narthex.
roles.deacon: Carry censer, walk ahead of priest, censing the nave during procession.
roles.cantor: Chant the Litiya stichera of the Feast or Saint during procession.

roles.priest: Stand in narthex before the tetrapod, make three bows.
roles.deacon: Cense the local icons in the narthex, then cense the priest, clergy, and people.

roles.priest: Exclaim the priestly prayer 'Hear us, O God...'
roles.deacon: Intone the litany of the Litiya ('O God, save Your people...').
roles.cantor: Respond 'Lord, have mercy' 40x, 30x, 50x after each appointed petition.

roles.priest: Process from narthex into the nave, stand before the tetrapod.
roles.deacon: Lead procession carrying the candle, stand at tetrapod.
roles.cantor: Sing the Aposticha stichera during the return procession.
